test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'LETTUCE' is written as 'ECUTTEL' and ‘PEPPERS’ is written as ‘SREPPEP’. How will 'PARSNIP' be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'LETTUCE' is written as 'ECUTTEL' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a750e382ac846edae4addae9df7ed43953402294d883a09924c1a5c608dc4a68.png] 

‘PEPPERS’ is written as ‘SREPPEP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0d63e855514bd62462c0e29868ce72ac24a0900db20bb773204bb4c8545d31c.png] 

Similarly, 'PARSNIP' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c4bbc72ca003878644e787d2ff926e6fd393e1ee75de612f6882b164dd32111.png] 

Hence,** 'option 3' **is the correct answer.
